<MEMORY file="memories/feedback-use-absolute-paths.md" action="update">
---
name: feedback-use-absolute-paths
description: Give full absolute file paths, never bare or relative ones, when the session is remote-controlled - and in every handover document
type: feedback
source: claude
captured: 2026-07-24
visibility: shared
domain: personal
---
When a session is driven remotely (phone or remote access rather than at the keyboard),
every file mentioned in a reply - status docs, code, config, logs - gets its full absolute
path from `/`, not a path relative to an assumed working directory.

**Why:** a bare `docs/plans/STATUS.md` forced a "where is this file?" round trip. Remote,
there is no prompt to glance at to infer the working directory.

**Extends to handover documents.** The same rule applies to any handover, plan or status
file written for a *later* session to pick up. A handover is read cold, in an unknown
working directory, often by a different tool.

Related: [[project-alpha-pipeline]]
</MEMORY>
